transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, forklift battery B-14 overheated while charging at Dock 2, producing smoke but no visible flame. Dock 2 remains closed until I authorize a controlled reopening with the required safety controls in place. In the meantime, the warehouse must continue processing outbound orders from the other docks. Per our incident-response routine, I need current findings from maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing before I can authorize reopening. Let's get started — could each area please report your current findings?

transcript.text: This is Elias, Maintenance. My inspection found internal cell damage in battery B-14. It must be removed from the charger and isolated in the steel battery cabinet for exactly 24 hours before any disposition. I've recorded the inspection in the maintenance log, but I want to flag that the incident channel has not yet been updated with this finding.
